title: Offline reported-attention direction inference with motor and mixture controls
disposition_reason: An independent evaluator implements report-label construction, complete nominal trial accounting, protected-split planning and probability scoring. No authentic MAT-to-inventory adapter, candidate input transport or fitted comparator has been delivered; published attention accuracy is not a threshold for this revised context.

scientific_target.question: Does identical offline EEG/audio information predict held-person, held-mixture left/right reports beyond motor/report timing, speech identity and trial-order alternatives?
scientific_target.known_answer: The left/right reported state occupying more than half of a non-overlapping one-second target interval, derived from initial state and timed key events. Undefined initial state and duration ties are explicit exclusions.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Participant behavioral report markers aligned to stimuli; they are not independent measurements of internal attention. Passive control labels are alternating keys, not passive attention.
scientific_target.case_unit: One eligible one-second target interval with a complete common two-second EEG context from one active or passive trial.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 18 participants; windows, trials and three mixture folds are dependent within person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline report-state decoding across held participants and mixture families. Motor, ocular and latency alternatives remain possible even with a two-second keypress guard.
exclusions: Online or causally prospective decoding from the offline derivative.
Attention specificity inferred solely from accuracy, a keypress guard, or passive-control failure.
Unseen-speaker or sentence generalization before stimulus overlap graph is verified.

inputs: Identical EEG interval [t-0.5s,t+1.5s) for target [t,t+1s), fixed 128-Hz normalized sample grid, common channels and valid-sample mask.

Identical presented two-channel audio and declared offline envelope transform for every method; no method-specific additional context. Native retained channel identities and audio alignment remain unresolved.
forbidden_inputs: Report labels, key-event times, initial-state truth, trial filenames/IDs, participant/mixture/block identities and evaluator-only exclusion/stratum annotations.
Prepared evaluator rows and full inventory: both contain target/report information and are not candidate packets.
Neighboring-trial padding or method-specific case deletion.
observation_contract.case_identity: Evaluator case_id is SHA256 of [registered task ID, normalized trial_id, target start_ns]. It is a deterministic accounting key, not a secret or evidence of anonymization; participant transport needs separate opaque binding and sanitized observations.
observation_contract.split: Implemented plan has 54 cells: 18 held participants x 3 mixture-family folds, excludes held participant and held mixture fold from all training trials. Native complete mixture/utterance overlap graph and freeze remain unverified.
observation_contract.coverage: Accounts for all nominal 1,080 active and 180 passive trial slots. One-second windows enter only with defined majority state and entire valid aligned 2-second context; exclusions remain per-person/block counts. No authentic eligible case count established.

primary.name: Participant-macro balanced accuracy of active reported direction
primary.aggregation: Pool active confusion counts across all three mixture folds within each person, compute that person balanced accuracy, then average all 18 equally.
primary.rationale: Prevents one-class folds or unequal window support from changing the estimand. Any person lacking either class makes the all-18 primary unestimable.

secondary: All-18/eligible-denominator log loss, Brier and calibration; report each class count and coverage.
At-least-two-seconds-from-keypress and transition-distance/switch-density strata, with no attention-purity interpretation.
Passive key-report motor diagnostic plus block/order strata.
Paired participant bootstrap interval and sign-flip test only under its symmetric/exchangeable-null assumption.

comparators.name: Independent backward TRF reconstruction
comparators.inputs: Same EEG interval/audio; 0–500 ms lag orientation and padding frozen to match other methods.
comparators.procedure: Reimplement the described ridge TRF explicitly as an independent baseline (alpha=100 reference recipe), with any tuning grouped within training; official trainer absent.

comparators.name: Regularized covariance/log-bandpower EEG classifier
comparators.inputs: Identical full two-second EEG context and permitted audio access.
comparators.procedure: Train-only features, normalization and logistic or shrinkage-LDA tuning; prospective competent baseline, not yet run.

comparators.name: Compact EEG temporal decoder
comparators.inputs: Same channels, masks and context as TRF/classifier.
comparators.procedure: Prospective EEGNet/TCN-style reference with frozen compute and training seeds, grouped validation.

comparators.name: Time/audio/EOG/motor shortcut controls
comparators.inputs: Class prior, time-within-trial, speaker-side/audio-only or available EOG inputs; passive key reports evaluator-only.
comparators.procedure: Compare on identical primary cases; retain passive and key-distance diagnostics and phase-preserving shifted-EEG control. Controls are specified, not fitted.

nuisance_controls: Reconcile 60 active plus 10 final passive trials and actual order before authentic use; final passive condition introduces distribution shift.
Audit source removing final four channels and trigger selection 11–70; neither proves passive absence or a 64-channel retained input.
Offline filtering may spread movement/future information across the nominal window; common sample support does not remove this.
Keep majority duration/tie policy, edge masks, lag orientation and audio transform common to every arm.
Never average per-fold balanced accuracies or silently discard one-class participants.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired participant resampling over 18 participants; implementation default is 2,000 bootstrap draws, seed 1729, and exact 2^18 sign flips when all paired effects are estimable. Windows/folds are not independent participants.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require unique finite p_right in [0,1] for every eligible active and passive case. Missing/nonfinite predictions fail the contract rather than change eligibility. Undefined all-18 balanced accuracy remains null with the exact denominator; report eligible-subset secondary separately.

implementation.scorer_target: Behaviorally reported left/right majority-state labels, with active participant-macro scoring and separate passive key-report diagnostic; neither paper-result copying nor direct attention truth.
implementation.delivered_scope: Normalized evaluator inventory validator, timing/label preparation, 54 split cells, full case prediction validation, metrics and grouped uncertainty; no neural sample packet or participant runtime.
missing: Authentic processed MAT/audio/trigger/channel census and complete active/passive/mixture alignment.
Sanitized input packet/opaque participant IDs and protected mode-specific transport.
Independent competent baselines and frozen stimulus overlap graph.
Resolve code/stimulus/HRTF reuse terms relevant to delivery without dropping necessary audio.
implementation.execution_evidence: Initial evaluator source and generated tests are retained. No authentic archive census, baseline model trial, direct/viewer trial or scientific qualification is established; publisher performance remains source-reported under a different protocol.

direct_observation.representation: Potential no-tools numerical or waveform interpretation of the common 2-second EEG plus admitted audio representation.
direct_observation.boundary: Represent every sufficient channel/sample without label-derived selection; evaluator rows must never be shown.
missing: No candidate packet, validated compact representation or direct-model transport.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed EEG/audio inspection constrained to the same offline context.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed actions return permitted renderings only; no report markers, target labels or neighboring trials.
missing: No typed viewer implementation or rendering information-equivalence validation.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-case investigation using fixed numerical/decoder tools on matched EEG/audio observations.
tool_assisted.boundary: No evaluator feedback; train-only fitted artifacts and equal tool/context budgets.
missing: Evaluator-only prepare/split/score CLI does not provide participant investigation transport or admitted model tools.

frozen_program.representation: Frozen classifier/TRF/decoder with grouped training and immutable preprocessing recipe.
frozen_program.boundary: Hold person and mixture families, fit normalization/calibration only on training, retain every required case.
missing: No authentic loader, trained baseline or frozen-program participant runner.

evidence.supports: Preserved source registration, earlier review findings, full target and historical evidence; revision does not relabel these as new execution.
Exact duration-based report labels, common 2-second context, all-18 pooled-mixture scoring and passive key-report diagnostic.
Evaluator consumes normalized inventory only, with no MAT loading, models or protected execution.
Retained source identity and design provenance for independent evaluator.
Generated tests exercise masks, duration labels, dependent aggregation, complete predictions and source-independent statistical arithmetic.
Participant packet not supplied; prepared rows are evaluator-only and contain labels/metadata.

evidence.locator: Version v1 experimental design and files, metadata rechecked 2026-11-16
evidence.supports: 18 participants, 60 active trials plus final passive 10-trial control, two speech streams, report key events and released processed/audio archives.

evidence.locator: Retained official-source audit in original registration: README and src/AASD_processing.m only
evidence.supports: Preprocessing source does not deliver the paper Transformer/TRF trainers; channel and passive-block accounting remain native-audit requirements.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Initial evaluator source and generated tests are retained. No authentic archive census, baseline model trial, direct/viewer trial or scientific qualification is established; publisher performance remains source-reported under a different protocol.
excluded_claims: No attention-specific, online, SOTA or paper-performance reproduction claim.
No authentic participant-mode execution or model result.
Programme accuracy would not establish direct waveform interpretation.

summary: Distinguish report-state targets from internal attention and keep motor/passive-control limits explicit.
Bind the metric to pooled mixture-fold confusion within all 18 people and retain undefined-class accounting.
Identify the existing CLI as evaluator-only: deterministic case hashes and prepared labels cannot serve as a participant input interface.
revision.source_review: Inspected retained registration and named implementation source; reused pinned source-specific review and checked available official dataset metadata. No authentic payload or held labels read.
